newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in east, southeast Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in east, southeast Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes raided suspected guerrilla targets in eastern and southeastern Lebanon on Tuesday, Lebanese security sources said.
The sources said Israeli jets fired a number of rockets at a hill near the eastern town of Baalbek where the transmission antenna of the radio station of the pro-Iranian Hizbollah is situated.
Other sources said that at about the same time Israeli planes fired rockets into an area in southeastern Lebanon where the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command has bases.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack.

Hizbollah (Party of God) leads a guerrilla war on some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 allied local militia holding a border zone in south Lebanon to ward off cross-frontier attacks on northern Israel.
